content.short: Skiff is an end-to-end encrypted, wallet-native workspace for secure Mail, Calendar, Pages, and Drive.
content.description: Skiff is an end-to-end encrypted, wallet-native workspace that brings together Mail, Calendar, Pages, and Drive in one private environment. You can sign up, pay for access, and collaborate privately, or with your crypto wallet. All data is protected by end-to-end encryption, and you can also store information in a decentralized way on IPFS. This integrated suite lets you manage email, scheduling, documents, and storage within a single secure, privacy-conscious platform.
content.meta: Skiff is an end-to-end encrypted, wallet-native workspace with Mail, Calendar, Pages, and Drive. Discover Skiff and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
